vulnerability.title: libexpat through 2.4.9 heap use-after-free when XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate destroys the parent's shared DTD after an out-of-memory failure in parserCreate

fixed_releases.verified_content: At R_2_5_0 parserCreate sets parser->m_dtd = NULL before XML_ParserFree when the caller passed a DTD, so the parent's shared DTD is not destroyed on the encoding-name out-of-memory path. The change (5290462a) is first contained in R_2_5_0 and absent from R_2_4_4 and R_2_4_9.

vulnerability.category_l2: Use-after-free: a shared DTD is destroyed by XML_ParserFree when parserCreate fails on out-of-memory

description: XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate creates an external parameter-entity parser: with a NULL context it sets newDtd = oldDtd (line 1338) so the new parser shares the parent's DTD, and passes that DTD to parserCreate (line 1351). parserCreate calls parserInit, which copies the caller-supplied encoding name with copyString (line 1090). If that allocation fails, m_protocolEncodingName stays NULL and parserCreate takes its out-of-memory branch (lines 1069-1072): it calls XML_ParserFree(parser) and returns NULL. XML_ParserFree is guarded from destroying a shared DTD only by m_isParamEntity (line 1475), but m_isParamEntity is set to XML_TRUE only later in XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate (line 1409), after parserCreate has returned; on this path it never returns, so the guard is still XML_FALSE and dtdDestroy frees the parent parser's still-in-use DTD. The parent (or a sibling external parser) then dereferences freed DTD structures, a heap use-after-free. 2.5.0's fix 5290462a sets parser->m_dtd = NULL before XML_ParserFree whenever the caller passed a DTD.

critical_operation.description: parserCreate's encoding-name failure branch. parserInit has just failed to copy the caller's encodingName (m_protocolEncodingName is NULL), so the branch calls XML_ParserFree on the partially built parser. When called from XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate with a NULL context, that parser's m_dtd is the parent's shared DTD and m_isParamEntity is still XML_FALSE, so XML_ParserFree runs dtdDestroy on the parent's live DTD. The 2.5.0 fix adds `if (dtd) parser->m_dtd = NULL;` before this XML_ParserFree.

entry_point.description: The embedding application calls XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate with a NULL context and a non-NULL encoding name while its allocator is failing; the encoding-name copy in parserCreate fails and the shared DTD is destroyed.

source_crosscheck.notes: NVD Primary and CISA-ADP Secondary publish the identical 7.5 High vector and the CNA publishes no metric, so there is no score or level conflict; OSV carries the same vector. The records agree the defect affects libexpat through 2.4.9 and is fixed in 2.5.0. The CNA description names the overeager destruction of a shared DTD in XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate in out-of-memory situations, which matches the code path: parserCreate's encoding-name OOM branch frees the new parser before m_isParamEntity is set, and XML_ParserFree therefore destroys the parent's DTD. Upstream's expat/Changes entry for 2.5.0 explicitly attributes CVE-2022-43680 to #616 #649 #650, and 5290462a is the lib change of PR #650 (merge 56967f83). OSV records no fixed GIT event, only last_affected d77291a4 (the 2.4.9 release merge), so the first fixed release is established from the tag and Changes entry.

required_before_promotion: An independent reviewer must read parserCreate and XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate at R_2_4_4 and confirm the OOM branch frees the new parser while m_isParamEntity is still XML_FALSE, so the parent's shared DTD is destroyed.

An independent reviewer must confirm the attacker/model: the application must invoke XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate with a NULL context and a non-NULL encoding name while allocation fails; XML content alone is not sufficient.
An independent reviewer must confirm 5290462a is the CVE-2022-43680 code fix (via the 2.5.0 Changes entry and PR #650) and is first contained in R_2_5_0.
An independent reviewer must confirm the '<2.5.0' range and the 7.5 High metrics.

independent_corrections_accepted: Compile-time precondition: the mechanism requires an XML_DTD-enabled build; the record adds this to its limitations.

Alias semantics: DEBIAN-CVE-2022-43680 is a separate Debian-feed OSV record whose upstream is CVE-2022-43680, not an element of the CVE OSV alias array (which lists A-255449293 and ASB-A-255449293); it is kept as a downstream cross-reference.

Line context: the fix diff hunk applies at old line 1068 on the post-2.4.9 master state, while the snapshot's branch is at 1069-1072; the record's line numbers are scoped to the snapshot, which the reviewer confirmed exactly.
Shallow-mirror caveat: `git tag --contains` under-reports later tags (for example R_2_6_0); first-contained and presence conclusions were verified by direct blob inspection and ancestry checks.
review.duplicate_check: Reviewer confirmed CVE-2022-40674 is the 2.4.9 doContent raw-name use-after-free, the five 2.4.5 CVEs (25235/25236/25313/25314/25315) are different fixes, and no other CVE shares fix commit 5290462a.

limitations: Static verification only; nothing was built, executed, parsed, or made to run out of memory.

Reachability depends on the embedding application calling XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate with a NULL context and a non-NULL encoding name while its allocator fails; the CVE describes this as an out-of-memory condition, and this dossier does not claim an attacker can force it.
The upstream Changes text says the expected impact is denial of service or potentially arbitrary code execution; exploitability beyond denial of service was not assessed.
OSV records no fixed GIT event for this CVE (only last_affected d77291a4); the fixed release 2.5.0 is established from the upstream Changes entry and tag containment of 5290462a.
Location range 1069-1072 is the four-line out-of-memory branch in parserCreate; parserInit's failing copyString at line 1090 and XML_ParserFree's guard at line 1475 are recorded in the trace.
The mechanism requires a build with XML_DTD enabled, because the shared-DTD path and the m_isParamEntity guard are inside #ifdef XML_DTD. The record does not claim a non-DTD build is affected.

The reviewer verified the snapshot blob, all cited line numbers (1031, 1090, 1338, 1351, 1409, 1475), the 5290462a patch, the 2.5.0 expat/Changes entry and ancestry; nothing was built, parsed or made to run out of memory.
open_questions: Whether a remote attacker can reliably induce the allocator failure at exactly the encoding-name copy (the CVE frames it as OOM) was not assessed; the CVSS vector's AC:L reflects the published NVD analysis, not an attacker-controlled trigger.
